decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that resultant two-storey detached four-bedroom dwellinghouse, because of its position, design, scale and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 102 Wellington Road North, and would be compatible with the character and appearance of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan policies (Adopted December 2003) ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4, H.4.1, and T.1.4.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are occupied.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the south elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the roofor any walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 102 Wellington Road North.
description: Erection of first floor extension to existing bungalow to create detached 2 storey 4 bedroomed house.
